stages.title: Coach workflows

stages.title: Operations, support and recovery

stages.title: Data, content and integration completion
stages.evidence_note: Seventh migration with Auth zero-grant onboarding, scoped commands and disclosure/policy draft extensions applied and verified remotely; owner content and provider configuration remain pending.

stages.title: Responsive, Arabic and visual acceptance
stages.evidence_note: Public96 checks and3 interactions pass; private88 initial and24 targeted rechecks use synthetic provider fixtures. Final reviewed scope remains explicit.

stages.title: Security and end-to-end release verification
stages.evidence_note: Build/lint and464 tests pass;30 SQL fixture checks pass against applied migration bytes; live schema/advisor checks pass; real Auth/role acceptance remains pending.

stages.title: Deploy and hand over the finished website
stages.evidence_note: No live deployment, real account acceptance, or production handover established.
